mapper.select: SELECT ah.id AS id, ah.tenant_id AS tenantId, ah.device_id AS deviceId, dbi.device_code AS deviceCode, dbi.device_name AS deviceName, dbi.device_type_name AS deviceTypeName, dbi.device_sub_type_name AS deviceSubTypeName, ah.alarm_code AS alarmCode, ah.alarm_text AS alarmText, ah.alarm_level AS alarmLevel, ah.start_ts AS startTs, ah.end_ts AS endTs, extract(epoch from now()) * 1000 - ah.start_ts AS durationMs, ah.is_active AS isActive FROM biz_device_mgmt.alarm_history ah INNER JOIN biz_device_base.device_base_info dbi ON ah.device_id = dbi.id WHERE ah.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dbi.factory_id = #{factoryId} AND ah.is_active = true ORDER BY (extract(epoch from now()) * 1000 - ah.start_ts) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
